name: gki
description: Build Android GKI kernel modules and make KMI-safe kernel changes on ACK android14-6.1, android15-6.6, android16-6.12 and android17-6.18, with per-branch facts: symbol lists and trimming, the MODULE_SIG_PROTECT gate, KCFI-safe callbacks, vendor hooks, kprobes, Rust on 6.12+, and what a self-built kernel must keep for stock vendor modules.
